legal_ref: UStG § 12 Abs. 1; § 28 Abs. 1 UStG (temporary 16% from 1 July to 31 December 2020)
quote: (1) Die Steuer beträgt für jeden steuerpflichtigen Umsatz 19 Prozent der Bemessungsgrundlage (§§ 10, 11, 25 Abs. 3 und § 25a Abs. 3 und 4). — Tax is 19% of the taxable amount for every taxable supply. [§ 28 Abs. 1: '§ 12 Absatz 1 ist vom 1. Juli 2020 bis 31. Dezember 2020 mit der Maßgabe anzuwenden, dass die Steuer ... 16 Prozent ... beträgt.' — 16% applied 1 Jul–31 Dec 2020, so 19% applies again from 1 Jan 2021]
source_title: Umsatzsteuergesetz (UStG) § 12 Steuersätze, gesetze-im-internet.de (Bundesministerium der Justiz); also § 28 UStG https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ustg_1980/__28.html

reduced_rates.scope: foodstuffs and other goods in Anlage 2 (excl. beverages other than water/milk drinks), books, newspapers and periodicals incl. electronic, local public passenger transport, short-term accommodation, cultural admissions, restaurant and catering services excluding beverages (UStG § 12 Abs. 2)
supply and installation of solar modules, components and storage for photovoltaic systems on or near dwellings/public-benefit buildings (UStG § 12 Abs. 3)

notes: 19% standard rate originally introduced 1 January 2007 (previously 16%); reduced temporarily to 16% from 1 July to 31 December 2020 (§ 28 Abs. 1 UStG), so the current 19% period runs from 1 January 2021. Restaurant/catering food is listed in § 12 Abs. 2 Nr. 15 at 7% (excluding beverages). Heligoland and Büsingen are outside the VAT territory. Small-business threshold under § 19 UStG. Zero rate effectively via exemptions with deduction for exports and intra-EU supplies (§ 4 Nr. 1). TEDB (situation 2026-07-01) also shows 19%. No enacted future change found.
